How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

Hi, normally you choose your estimated delivery timeframe at checkout, and the order is scheduled to ship in time for that window. Once the package is scanned by the carrier, the tracking email is sent automatically.

A few helpful details:

In the U.S., you select an estimated arrival date at checkout.
If you use Shop Pay, PayPal, or another express checkout option, the delivery date is assigned automatically.
Tracking usually goes out when the box is physically scanned by FedEx or USPS, so it can arrive a bit later than the order confirmation.
Large orders can ship in more than one box, and each box gets its own tracking number.

If you want, send me your order number or checkout email and I can check your specific order status.

turns.q: Can I reroute the package to a different address?
turns.replyTail:
the package to a different address?

Hi, yes, if you need the package sent to a different address, our customer care team can help with that by phone.

Shipping address changes are handled over the phone because updating the destination can change taxes based on the new location, and any payment adjustment needs to be taken care of correctly at the same time.

Our team can be reached at (800) 820-0465. We are available Monday–Friday 6:00AM–4:00PM and Saturday 8:00AM–4:00PM PST.
